ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The left side of the figure is marked with AC voltage u. The circuit starts from the upper-left terminal and passes in sequence through resistor R1, inductor L, to resistor R2 on the right vertical branch, then through capacitor C, and finally returns to the lower-left terminal by the bottom wire; these components are located in the same loop, with no parallel branches, so R1, L, R2, and C are passed through in sequence by the same current. Reasoning: Since u is a sinusoidal AC voltage with angular frequency ω, the phasor-domain model is adopted. The total impedance of the series circuit is equal to the sum of the impedances of the components: Z = R1 + jωL + R2 + 1/(jωC). Also because 1/(jωC) = -j/(ωC), so Z = (R1 + R2) + j(ωL - 1/(ωC)). The impedance magnitude is the square root of the sum of the squares of the real part and the imaginary part, therefore |Z| = sqrt((R1 + R2)^2 + (ωL - 1/(ωC))^2).

method.method_draft: First describe the circuit as a series chain: R1, L, R2, and C are all traversed by the same current. Then take the modulus to obtain |Z|=sqrt((R1+R2)^2+(ωL-1/(ωC))^2).

method.method_draft: First describe the image as one series loop containing R1, L, R2, and C across the source u. Let the common current amplitude be I. The in-phase voltage component is I(R1+R2). The net quadrature voltage component is IωL - I/(ωC), because the inductive and capacitive drops are opposite in phase. Therefore |U|=I*sqrt((R1+R2)^2+(ωL-1/(ωC))^2). Divide by I to get |Z|=sqrt((R1+R2)^2+(ωL-1/(ωC))^2).

图像描述：图中左侧是标注为 u 的正弦交流电压源端，电路从上方依次经过电阻 R1、线圈电感 L，到右侧竖直支路上的电阻 R2，再经过下方的电容 C，最后由底部导线返回左侧端点。图中没有并联分支，因此 R1、L、R2、C 与电源 u 构成一个串联回路。

推理：设串联回路中的公共电流幅值为 I。两个电阻的电压降与电流同相，其合成同相分量为 I(R1+R2)。电感电压超前电流 90°，幅值为 IωL；电容电压滞后电流 90°，幅值为 I/(ωC)，二者相位相反，所以净正交分量为 IωL - I/(ωC)。因此电源电压幅值满足 |U| = I * sqrt((R1+R2)^2 + (ωL - 1/(ωC))^2)。由 |Z| = |U|/I，得到 |Z| = sqrt((R1+R2)^2 + (ωL - 1/(ωC))^2)。
